t: You're looking at Marconi House, a Grade II listed building at 335 Strand. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, who is considered one of the greatest of British architects. He worked from the 1870s to the 1900s, and he was known for country houses and for commercial buildings. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. So this is a city building by a man best known for his country houses, which makes it a good one to look up at for a moment while the Strand moves past you.
